scope_checked.method: Subject-scoped rg search for rate-distortion, source coding, quantization, Blahut/Arimoto, Gaussian water-filling, source-channel separation, Wyner-Ziv and successive refinement; inspected candidate item identifiers, frontmatter status and relevant definitions/proof scope. This is not a whole-repository audit.

information_theory_category.finding: No published local classical rate-distortion/source-coding supplier was found.

items.supplies: Underlying measurable-space, sigma-algebra, and measure-space terminology.
Probability-law normalization and probability measure interface.
Standard Borel measurable-space terminology; needed when invoking regular conditional distributions.
Measurable kernel and probability kernel definitions.
items.caveat: A definition does not establish regular conditional-kernel existence or select a version.

items.supplies: Randomized procedure/Markov-kernel interface.
Regular conditional distribution existence under the stated standard-Borel and probability hypotheses.
Standard-Borel disintegration of a joint law, including its a.e.-uniqueness scope.
Consistent finite-dimensional laws extend to standard-Borel coordinate products under its stated hypotheses.
Radon-Nikodym derivative terminology.
RN density existence and uniqueness with explicit absolute-continuity and sigma-finiteness hypotheses.
Directional law-level KL definition, +infinity when absolute continuity fails, RN integral on the absolutely continuous part, conventions, and finite negative-part/well-definedness proof.
items.caveat: Does not prove joint convexity, optimization-domain lower semicontinuity, conditional chain rules, or Markov-kernel data processing.

items.supplies: KL nonnegativity and equality iff the two laws agree, plus a normalized-density variational identity under its stated hypotheses.
items.caveat: Not a general KL variational formula, DPI, joint-convexity, or lsc supplier.

items.supplies: Finite-product KL additivity under its stated conditions.
items.caveat: Does not supply a general conditional KL chain rule or data-processing theorem.

items.supplies: Finite Jensen inequality used in finite-alphabet entropy/log-sum/convexity arguments.
Expectation Jensen inequality under the stated integrability/nonnegative-expectation hypotheses.
Definitions of convex and concave functions.
Gradient supporting-hyperplane inequality for differentiable convex functions under its stated domain assumptions.
Hessian test for convexity on the stated open convex domains.
Basic convexity-preserving operations.
Uniform-integrability plus convergence-in-probability yields L1 convergence under its stated conditions; useful for default-distortion tail control.
A.s. and L1 convergence for conditional expectations along an increasing filtration under the item hypotheses.
Finite probability-vector entropy in natural logarithms and finite stochastic-matrix conventions.
items.caveat: Not a general entropy/conditional entropy/MI supplier, and does not by itself prove the full rate-distortion theorem.

items.supplies: Mutual information for a uniform finite-hypothesis experiment as an average of KL terms.
items.caveat: Not general MI for arbitrary joint laws and priors.

items.supplies: Quantum trace-distance contractivity under quantum channels.
items.caveat: Not classical mutual-information data processing or quantum relative-entropy data processing.

missing_information_theory_suppliers.missing: General finite entropy, conditional entropy, MI, chain rules, conditioning-reduces-entropy, independence characterization, finite DPI, log-sum and MI convexity as reusable theorem items.
missing_information_theory_suppliers.handoff: For a finite-alphabet scaffold, prove these from finite sums/Jensen/log-sum and the finite KL definition; do not cite the uniform-hypothesis experiment item as general MI.

library_items_not_to_overclaim.reason: A finite-only entropy/stochastic-matrix interface, not a general Shannon theorem layer.
Uniform finite-hypothesis MI only, not arbitrary joint-law mutual information.
Nonnegativity and a scoped variational identity do not imply general KL joint convexity, lsc, DPI, or BA convergence.
A loss-specific exponential update, not general information projection or alternating-minimization convergence.
Quantum trace-distance DPI, not a classical MI/KL data-processing supplier.
